query:
SELECT h.number AS "unit_number!", h.title AS "unit_title!", t.slug AS "track_slug!", a.sequence AS "attempt_sequence!", j.performer AS "performer!", j.verifier_id AS "verifier?", j.spec -> 'verifier' ->> 'revision' AS "revision?", j.created_at AS "waiting_since!: _" FROM jobs j
            JOIN attempts a ON a.id = j.attempt_id
            JOIN units h ON h.id = a.unit_id
            JOIN tracks t ON t.id = a.track_id
            WHERE 
        j.project_id = $1 AND j.phase = 'verify' AND j.state = 'pending'
        AND j.created_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $2)
    
            ORDER BY j.created_at, j.id
            LIMIT $3
